CN: 修复与 SaltyNX、Horizon-OC 的冲突崩溃问题
崩溃原因是系统服务克隆数耗尽，虽然通过改成不克隆直连服务解决了崩溃
但是按照以往版本的经历，这样做会和极个别游戏发生因为系统服务会话数耗尽引起崩溃的问题
只能说在不阉割核心功能的前提，将就用吧
EN: Fixed crashes caused by conflicts with SaltyNX and Horizon-OC.
The crashes were caused by exhausting the system service’s capacity for cloned sessions. Switching to direct service connections without cloning resolved the crashes.
However, based on experience with previous versions, this approach may cause crashes in a small number of games due to system service session limits being reached.
For now, this is a compromise we’ll have to live with to preserve the core functionality.
